test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

He behaved __ruthlessly__ with his junior, to say the least.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 2)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ruthlessly"** means showing no pity or compassion for others; cruelly. (निर्दयता से)

 
 
• **Example: **The dictator ruled the country ***ruthlessly***, instilling fear in the hearts of the people.
 
 
 
• **"Inhumanly"** refers to acting in a way that is cruel, brutal, and lacking human feelings. (अमानवीय रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers treated the prisoners* **inhumanly**,* showing no mercy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym is '**Inhumanly**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unexpectedly** (अप्रत्याशित रूप से): Occurring without warning or in a way that was not anticipated.

 
 
• **Example:** She ***unexpectedly*** received a promotion at work.
 
 
 
• **Weirdly** (अजीब तरह से): In a manner that is strange or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** He behaved*** weirdly*** at the party, making everyone feel uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Politely** (सौम्यता से): In a respectful and considerate manner.
 
 
• **Example:** She ***politely ***declined the invitation to the event.
 
 

39a:Tcf3,

The correct answer is ***Option 3)***
